sections.title: Performance Testing Services in India FAQs

items.q: What is performance testing in simple terms?
items.a: Performance testing is the process of checking how your software behaves under heavy user load to ensure it does not slow down or crash. It answers questions like: "Will my app handle 10,000 users at once?"

items.q: Why is performance testing important for Indian businesses?
items.a: During high traffic events like festival sales, product launches, or marketing campaigns, many Indian applications crash due to lack of load preparation. Performance testing prevents this.

items.q: Do you provide performance testing for mobile apps?
items.a: Yes, we test mobile apps for speed, stability, and backend performance under load. Both Android and iOS apps are covered.

items.q: What tools do you use for performance testing?
items.a: We use JMeter, K6, LoadRunner, and custom performance monitoring tools based on your specific requirements.

items.q: How long does a performance test take?
items.a: Typically 2-4 weeks depending on application complexity. This includes planning, execution, analysis, and optimization recommendations.
